model.temperature: not explicitly configurable through the frozen Codex harness
model.nondeterminism_note: A single run remains potentially nondeterministic even without an exposed sampling-temperature control.
model.repeat_policy: Two independent clean workspaces; provider seed is not exposed.

commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc 'git -C /workspace status --short; git -C /workspace/asn1ber status --short; git -C /workspace log -1 --oneline; git -C /workspace/asn1ber log -1 --oneline'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "find . -path '*/.git' -prune -o -name '*.ets' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.json5' -print | sed -n '1,240p'; rg -n 'Index|result|message|run' entry/src/main entry/src/ohosTest AppScope README* oh-package.json5 entry/oh-package.json5"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf 'this.result occurrences: '; rg -o 'this\\.result' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | wc -l; printf 'this.result += occurrences: '; rg -o 'this\\.result \\+=' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | wc -l; printf 'methods: '; rg -n '"'^  private |''^  build'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type d -name .git -print; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f -name HEAD -o -name config | sed -n '1,80p'; git -C /workspace/asn1ber rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>&1 || true"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^  private [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*'"\\(' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | sed -n '205,330p'; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | sed -n '600,790p'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf 'methods: '; rg -c '"'^  private [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*'"\\(\\) \\{"'$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; printf 'locals: '; rg -c '"'^    let result = this.result$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; printf 'commits: '; rg -c '"'^    this.result = result$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; printf 'state mutations: '; rg -c 'this\\.result \\+=' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets || true; printf 'alerts frozen: '; jq '[.[] | select(.rule==\"@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var\")] | length' .exp_agent/findings_round_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -n --slurpfile findings .exp_agent/findings_round_01.json '
  def repair("'$rule; $locations; $entities; $invariants; $evidence; $transformation): {
    rule: $rule,
    relative_path: "entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets",
    locations: $locations | map({line: .line, column: .column}),
    owning_entities: $entities,
    applicable_invariants: $invariants,
    repository_evidence: $evidence,
    transformation_summary: $transformation,
    status: "repaired"
  };
  {
    selected_rules: [
      "@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var",
      "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var",
      "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api"
    ],
    consulted_specs: {
      "@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var": [
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/core-invariants.md",
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/state-reactivity.md"
      ],
      "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var": [
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/core-invariants.md",
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/state-reactivity.md"
      ],
      "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api": [
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/core-invariants.md",
        "/codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/computation-api.md"
      ]
    },
    consulted_guides: {},
    entity_repairs: [
      repair(
        "@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var",
        ($findings[] | select(.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var")),
        ["Index.result accumulation across read and write test methods"],
        ["state ownership and reactive UI updates", "preserve evaluation order and accumulated output", "preserve all method declarations and call sequencing"],
        ["Index.result is rendered by Text(this.result) in build", "all producers are private synchronous test methods called in a fixed sequence by the Button onClick handler", "the methods only append deterministic validation text and no external caller mutates result between their statements"],
        "Preserved @State result and every existing method; each method now accumulates into a local result string and assigns the completed value to this.result once, retaining the original append order and final displayed output."
      ),
      repair(
        "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var",
        ($findings[] | select(.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var")),
        ["Index.message field and Button(this.message) read"],
        ["state ownership and reactive UI updates", "resource identity and user-visible value", "preserve the component field declaration"],
        ["message has only its initializer and the build-time Button(this.message) read; rg found no assignments or mutations after initialization", "the initializer resolves app.string.run from the entry module resources", "base and zh_CN string resources both define the run key"],
        "Kept the message field and initializer but removed only the unnecessary @State decorator because the value is immutable for the component lifetime."
      ),
      repair(
        "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api",
        ($findings[] | select(.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api")),
        ["Index.message resource initializer"],
        ["resource identity and module/type compatibility", "preserve the resolved user-visible string", "preserve initializer evaluation order"],
        ["the initializer uses the generated app.string.run resource in entry/src/main/resources/base/element/string.json", "the same run key exists in entry/src/main/resources/zh_CN/element/string.json", "the only synchronous resource lookup is getStringSync in the message initializer"],
        "Changed getStringSync($r('"'app.string.run')) to getStringSync("'$r('"'app.string.run').id), preserving the same resource key and fallback/resource selection while using its generated numeric ID.\"
      )
    ],
    unresolved_external: []
  }
' > .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^  (private )?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*'"\\(["'^)]*'"\\) \\{"'$|''^    this'"\\.result = result"'$|''^    let result = this.result$|''^  }$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | tail -n 90"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq empty .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json && printf 'report-json-valid\\n'; printf 'source-local-count='; rg -c '"'^    let result = this.result$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; printf 'source-commit-count='; rg -c '"'^    this.result = result$'"' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets; printf 'state-append-count='; (rg -c 'this\\.result \\+=' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets || true); printf 'frozen-location-count='; jq '[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "git diff --no-index -- /dev/null entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets >/tmp/index_current_diff 2>/dev/null || true; wc -l entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json; rg -n 'this\\.result \\+=|@State message|getStringSync\\(\\"'$r'"\\(' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets || true; rg -n 'getStringSync\\(\\"'$r'"\\(' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^  @State|''^  message|''^  private (read|write|complex|long|oversized|nested|multiple)|''^    let result = this.result$|''^    this.result = result$|this'"\\.result \\+=' entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets | sed -n '1,180p'"
